title: Hunga Tonga's water vapor vs the stratosphere's total

source.name: Millan et al., 'The Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai Hydration of the Stratosphere', Geophysical Research Letters

notes: NASA-funded researchers estimated the January 2022 Hunga Tonga eruption injected about 146 million metric tons of water vapor into the stratosphere -- roughly 10% of the ~1,460 million metric tons of water normally found there (146 is ~10% of 1,460; remainder shown as 1,314).
